summary: Hiker suffered an asthma attack near K2 off Capitol Peak. HAATS and Flight for Life helicopters were unable to reach the patient due to weather/flight restrictions; a CareFlight helicopter extracted her at ~1:38 AM on 9/6 and transported her to Aspen Valley Hospital. Her climbing partner was escorted out on foot. 13 MRA members involved.
location: K2 off Capitol Peak, Maroon Bells Wilderness Area
